newsitem.title: USA: EDS wins $69 million government contract.
newsitem.headline: EDS wins $69 million government contract.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems Corp. said Wednesday it won a $69 million contract to help modernise the Department of Agriculture's computer systems to improve monitoring of crop output and soil erosion.
The five-year contract will create an estimated 150 new jobs, it said.
The information services company said the work will be centred in Kansas City; St. Louis; Fort Collins, Colo.; and Washington.
EDS, based in Herndon, Va., had revenues of $12.4 billion in 1995 and has 95,000 employees.
EDS stock rose 37.5 cents to $46.375 on the New York Stock Exchange.
